launches.title: Patientdesk.ai: AI Native Operating System for Dental Clinics
launches.tagline: All-in-one operating system built for real dental workflows.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Patientdesk handles inbound and outbound calls, scheduling, live insurance verification, claims submission, and billing for dental clinics — all in one system. We grew from $17K to $50K MRR in 8 weeks and have driven $1.8M in incremental revenue for our customers.\
\
<https://youtu.be/1liipoEyTuk> 

👋 **Hi, we're Oncel, Şan, and Emre.**

We've been best friends since 2016. All three of us ranked #1 nationwide out of 1.2 million students on the Turkish national exam, ended up in the same high school dorm room, and have been working together ever since. Before Patientdesk, we ran a dental marketing agency and our own call center for two years. We didn't find this problem. It found us.

🔴 **The problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98988&key=user_uploads/2594817/da263c64-fc8a-45ab-a59f-a1bbb5702156)

The US dental industry processes $189 billion in services annually across 135,000 clinic locations. Yet the average practice runs on five disconnected tools that don't talk to each other. The consequences are severe:

* 15% of insurance claims are denied, 80% of those denials are preventable
* 65% of denied claims are never resubmitted
* Front desk staff spend up to 20 hours per week on manual insurance verification alone

Every time data moves between tools, a human moves it manually. A wrong code, a missing attachment, a verification that never made it to the claim. The clinic doesn't get paid. This is not a staffing problem. It's a coordination problem. And you can't fix a coordination problem by adding more tools.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98988&key=user_uploads/2594817/e7b525fc-ccb3-434f-be85-43a83ae665fd)

✅ **What we built**

Patientdesk is the AI-native operating system for dental practices. We started with the front office and we're building toward owning the entire stack.

Today we handle:

* **Inbound and outbound calls** — 24/7 coverage, no missed calls, no voicemails
* **Scheduling** — books directly into the practice management software
* **Live insurance verification** — we are the first system to verify insurance during the booking call, in real time, without any manual handoff
* **Claims submission and denial follow-up** — we submit claims directly and follow up on denials automatically so clinics stop leaving money on the table
* **Payments and billing** — automated reminders and collection

Our goal is to replace the $15,000/month stack clinics currently use with a single platform starting at $7,500/month.

📈 **Traction**

* $17K → $50K MRR in 8 weeks, 39% MoM growth
* $1.8M in incremental revenue driven for customers since September 2025
* 60+ clinics live across the US, Australia, and the UK
* Official voice provider for 2 major practice management platforms

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98988&key=user_uploads/2594817/d5a474a4-d274-4e8c-850a-7609529246a4)

🙏 **Our ask**

* Intros to dental groups, DSOs, or healthcare operators
* Feedback from founders who scaled vertical SaaS or voice-heavy products
* Anyone who has navigated insurance and claims workflows at scale

Happy to give any YC founder a live walkthrough.

Reach us at [founders@patientdesk.ai](mailto:founders@patientdesk.ai) or at [patientdesk.ai](http://patientdesk.ai)

launches.title: Patientdesk.ai: Patient-Aware AI Booking for Dental Clinics
launches.tagline: All-in-one patient intake system built for real dental workflows.
launches.body:
We’re **Oncel, San, and Emre**, founders of **Patientdesk**.\
\
One quick data point before we get into it.

In December alone, one of our customers generated $350k in revenue directly from Patientdesk bookings.\
\
**TL;DR**

Patientdesk is a **patient-aware AI booking system for dentists.** We handle calls, bookings, payments, and **real-time insurance verification during the call** so clinics capture more revenue and fill their calendars with higher-value appointments.\
\
We are growing rapidly, especially in the **US**. We are live in **60+ clinics** across the US, Australia, and the UK, partnered with **3 major practice management systems**, and have been **invited to exhibit at the world’s largest dental fairs like ADX**.

## <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTQU6bzZ-Ww>

## **The Problem**

Dental practices leak revenue at the front desk.

Calls come in while teams are busy or after hours. Try calling a dentist in the evening or on the weekend and it will usually go straight to voicemail.

Patients do not wait. They move on.

This becomes even more painful with paid acquisition. Clinics invest heavily in ads, but often follow up hours or days later. By then, the patient is gone.

What’s left:

* Missed opportunities
* Underutilized provider calendars
* High CAC with poor conversion

This bottleneck has existed for decades and worsens as clinics scale.

## **What We Built**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97818&key=user_uploads/2594817/80f45110-8b4d-47e2-8824-15d30704d9b2)

Patientdesk is an AI booking system built specifically for dental clinics.

Instead of solving one piece of the workflow, we run **patient intake end to end**, without increasing staff workload or forcing clinics to change how they operate.\
\
**Unlike generic booking tools, Patientdesk is patient-aware.**

It understands who is calling, their history with the clinic, and what type of appointment they are asking about, so conversations are handled with the right context instead of starting from zero every time.

Patientdesk covers:

* Incoming patient calls
* Intake and qualification
* Appointment booking
* **Insurance verification in real time during the call**
* Payments and deposits

All within a single system.

We are the first system that verifies insurance live during the call within a couple of seconds. This lets clinics confirm coverage and pricing immediately, instead of booking blindly or calling patients back later, which is where many high-value cases drop off.\
\
Patients get answers immediately instead of waiting for callbacks or manual checks.

## **How It Works**

Patientdesk integrates directly with major clinic management systems across the US, Australia, and the UK.

We have **active partnerships with three major practice management systems**, allowing us to book, update, and verify information directly inside clinic systems.

When something needs to be booked, checked, or updated, it happens automatically inside the clinic’s existing system.

If a patient asks about coverage, **insurance is verified on the spot**, typically within seconds.\
No follow-up calls. No dropped patients.

After the visit, Patientdesk continues to work:

* We follow up with patients
* When a payment is due, we handle it automatically

The front desk is no longer a bottleneck and becomes a revenue engine.

## **Traction**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97818&key=user_uploads/2594817/c67cb867-68bb-4fbd-9106-43aebb53e2d7)

* Live in **60+ clinics**, primarily dental, across the US, Australia, and the UK
* Growing rapidly in the **US dental market**
* Handling real patient calls every day
* Partnered with **3 major practice management systems**
* Invited to **the largest dental conferences and trade shows globally**

Patientdesk is already the core infrastructure for the clinics we support.

## **🔍 Why We’re Building This**

We did not arrive here by theory.

Before Patientdesk, we spent years working directly with clinics. We built workflows, trained front desk teams, and operated our own call center.

We saw that while there are tools for individual steps like phones, bookings, and insurance, nothing handles patient intake completely in one system.

Patientdesk came from that gap.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97818&key=user_uploads/2594817/2b5239db-0031-4bf5-98d0-397bb72c06ad)

## **🤝 Our Ask**

If any of the below resonate, we would love your help:

* Introductions to dental groups, DSOs, or healthcare operators
* Feedback on positioning such as AI receptionist versus intake or revenue platform
* Advice from founders who have scaled vertical SaaS or voice-heavy systems

Happy to give YC founders a live walkthrough.

📬 Reach us via DM or at [**founders@patientdesk.ai**](mailto:founders@patientdesk.ai)\
🌐 <https://www.patientdesk.ai>
